name: toast-32
description: A custom-rendered toast with a gradient badge for gamified achievements.

files.content:
"use client" import { TrophyIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Progress } from "@workspace/ui/components/progress" import { Toast, ToastContent, ToastDescription, ToastPortal, ToastProvider, ToastTitle, ToastViewport, createToastManager, useToastManager, } from "@workspace/ui/components/toast" const notify = createToastManager() function AchievementToasts() { const { toasts } = useToastManager() return toasts.map((t) => (
Achievement unlocked
)) } export default function AchievementUnlockedToast() { return (
Daily streak 6 / 7 days
) }
